t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Alternate the gnomes you pick until you can tell which one gives you the most?

vb_textbox.text: I genuinely don't think there's any legitimate strategy for this game. I got the EXACT same set of gnomes 2 times in a row, the same size the same colors everything. I picked the same gnome for both of these rounds and it yielded completely different results. I think every outcome for this game is random and it's trying to trick you into thinking otherwise.
